prompt: The agent produced one 3,000-line change that nobody can review.
why: Break the plan into small tasks, each a reviewable change.
trap: The plan may be fine; the unit of work is too big.

prompt: Each step should end with tests passing and a commit, so you can stop or roll back between steps.
tells: end with tests passing and a commit
why: Small verified tasks are natural checkpoints.
trap: Tests verify each task; the breakdown creates the tasks.

prompt: The task list has the UI before the API it calls, and the agent keeps stubbing things it can't test.
tells: the UI before the API it calls
why: Order tasks by dependency so each can be finished and verified.
trap: A contract would also help, but the order is the issue.

prompt: Two agents can work at once only if their tasks touch different files and don't need each other's results.
why: A good breakdown marks independent tasks that can run in parallel.
trap: The breakdown decides what can be parallel.
